title: 天明之约 · The Daybreak Vow · Janji Fajar
description: A war keeps a prince and a princess apart until daybreak. They sing the song as a duet in Mandarin.

title: Bintang Senja · The Evening Star · 暮星
description: A star falls at twilight. A young bugler carries her back to the sky. She sings the song in Indonesian.

title: Let Me Rise · Biar Aku Terbit · 如日初升
description: A young scribe paints the heroes of the temple wall. She wants a story of her own. She sings the song in English.

title: Un jour viendra · 终有一天 · Suatu Hari Nanti
description: A village boy joins the imperial army as its lowest servant. His spirit never goes out. He sings the song in French.

title: 山河为证 · Let the Land Bear Witness · Biar Tanah Air Menjadi Saksi
description: A boy of sixteen joins the Long March of 1934 to 1935. He loses his comrades on the road. He sings the song in Mandarin.

title: Urip Maneh · 再世相逢 · Alive Again
description: Two souls miss each other across four lives in Java. In the last life, she finds her own face on an old temple wall. Bayu sings the song in Javanese.
